facts.text: Tim decorated a Christmas tree with a Harry Potter theme.

evidence.quote: I decorated this tree myself, going all out with a Harry Potter theme! It was a blast!

facts.text: Tim expressed satisfaction with the outcome of the themed tree project.

evidence.quote: Thanks! It was such a fun project and I'm really happy with how it turned out.

facts.text: John complimented Tim on the themed tree and its overall appearance.

evidence.quote: That themed tree looks amazing! You really know how to get the vibes just right!
